distribution: Single Windows EXE with embedded web runtime and artwork
checks: Start built EXE with isolated cache and loopback port
Serve exact HTML, JavaScript, CSS, catalog and hunting data bytes
Serve all 2166 PNGs with matching SHA-256 hashes
Reopening the launcher reuses its running instance
Reject path traversal, foreign Host headers, malformed percent escapes and unsupported HTTP methods
Support HEAD, missing-file responses and simultaneous artwork requests
Include attribution and upstream license notices in embedded bundle
limitations: Tray menu and default-browser launch have not been exercised through UI automation
Clean Windows 10/11 machines and SmartScreen behavior have not been independently tested
Existing hunting audit limitations remain unchanged
